A solitary '''cyclops''' was located in a cage in the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. Unlike the [[cyclops|cyclopes]] in the [[Warriors' Guild]], this cyclops had the same drop table as a regular [[hill giant]]. According to the [[Zookeeper]], this cyclops was brought to the zoo by an explorer from a far away land, but little else is known because the explorer died shortly thereafter.{{CiteNPC|npc=Zookeeper|loc=Ardougne Zoo|quote=He's from a very far away land. We couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!}}

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Kandarin Area Graphical Update - This Week In RuneScape|date=15 January 2024}}
** To continue our work in refreshing older areas of the game to the visual standard we all want to see, we have made changes to Kandarin.
*** Removed cyclops spawns from Ardougne Zoo.

* {{UL|type=update|update=RS2 Launched!|date=29 March 2004}}
** The NPC was permanently added with the launch of ''RuneScape 2''.

* {{UL|type=update|update=RuneScape 2 Beta is Here!|date=1 December 2003}}
** The NPC was added to the ''RuneScape 2'' beta.
